keys.about.heading: About
keys.about.hero.subtitle: A quiz born for medicine, built with passion and code 💜
keys.about.history.title: Our story ✨
keys.about.history.p1: It all started in January 2026 with a specific challenge: the III Meeting of Medical Oncology Residents of Andalusia needed a multiplayer team quiz with trivial mode, and no platform on the market covered it 100%. Too many limitations, subscriptions or features that just didn't fit.
keys.about.history.p2: The solution was obvious: build it ourselves 🛠️. Rosa defined what it should be — the questions, the game modes, the experience — and Xisco turned it into code. Over coffee, nights of testing and the occasional "this isn't working as it should", XIRO! was born.
keys.about.history.p3: In February 2026 it was tested for the first time in a real game with Oncology residents and consultants 🏥. Some technical glitches, yes, but the reception was very good. That was enough to keep going.
keys.about.history.p4: Since then, constant evolution: new questions, translations, game modes, all kinds of improvements. Today, XIRO! is ready to go out into the world 🚀.
keys.about.timeline.idea.title: The spark
keys.about.timeline.idea.desc: The III Andalusian Oncology Residents Meeting needs the perfect quiz.
keys.about.timeline.dev.title: The development
keys.about.timeline.dev.desc: Rosa proposes, Xisco builds. Nights of coffee and code.
keys.about.timeline.launch.title: To the world
keys.about.timeline.launch.desc: First real game, continuous improvements and now... for everyone!
keys.about.team.title: The team 👩‍💻🧑‍💻
keys.about.team.subtitle: Those who make XIRO! possible
keys.about.team.rosa.desc: Oncologist with vision. She defined what XIRO! had to be: the questions, the game modes, the user experience. Without her ideas, there would be nothing to build ✨.
keys.about.team.xisco.desc: Rosa's ideas turned into code. Backend, frontend, database, real time... If XIRO! works, it's thanks to him (and quite a lot of coffee ☕).
keys.about.team.maria.desc: First to try each new version. Her verdict decides whether a question is cool or not 🔥.
keys.about.team.jaime.desc: Always wants to win, and that makes the game more fun. Finds bugs at the worst possible moments 🐛😅.
keys.about.philosophy.title: Made with passion, for professional games
keys.about.philosophy.desc: The foundation of the system is that it should be easy to create questions, very easy to manage and very easy to play. If it meets those three requirements, everything else follows naturally.
